subject: Sorry about Friday - I think I mixed up
text:
I just realized I may have completely mixed up Friday, and I feel terrible about it. I had written 'afternoon' in my calendar, but when I looked back I had also accepted a home delivery for the same window, then I thought maybe I had moved it, and then the notification appeared and everything suddenly made sense in the worst way.

I have also had three work requests land today, one of which is urgent, and the building access codes changed again, so I was running around trying to confirm details and ended up confusing two separate promises I thought I had already resolved. It is embarrassing, and I will set two alerts next time instead of trusting one optimistic entry and labels for every change in my planner.

I should have said something sooner instead of assuming you would probably understand. I am sorry, and I hate that you may have blocked time only to discover I was not going to arrive when expected. That is not fair to you, especially since you already helped me sort the earlier scheduling mess without making me feel awkward.

If Friday is too short notice to rearrange, I completely understand. Maybe we could meet Sunday morning, or Monday evening, or any other time that is less chaotic than my current week. I will be more careful with reminders.

Best,
Sam
